verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph provides a documented public Teams API that external services can call to automate Teams: creating teams and channels, adding members, configuring tabs and apps, posting chatMessages to channels, and exporting chat and channel content. A community report confirms the API exists but notes that integrating requires the full Azure/Graph stack. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths, and the heavy Azure/Graph setup makes it harder for lightweight or agent-driven use.
